totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.required: Two-step verification is mandatory for administrators: set it up to continue.

totp.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
totp.step2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows now.
totp.step3: Save these recovery codes: each works once if you lose your phone.
